title: refactor(vue-query): add the 'override' modifier to members that override a base class member
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Adds the TypeScript `override` modifier to the methods that `QueryClient` (including its overload signatures), `QueryCache`, and `MutationCache` override from their `query-core` base classes.

These wrappers unwrap the refs and getters before calling the base method. With `override`, TypeScript reports an error if a `query-core` method is renamed or removed, instead of silently leaving the wrapper as a new, unused method.

`override` is erased at compile time, so the built JS and the type declarations are unchanged. The generated reference docs only update "Defined in" line numbers, since some signatures now wrap.

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] I have followed the steps in the [Contributing guide](https://github.com/TanStack/query/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have tested code changes locally with `pnpm run test:pr`, or these tests do not apply to this pull request.
- [x] I have followed the [AI contribution policy](https://github.com/TanStack/query/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md) and fully understand the code in this pull request, including any code generated with AI assistance.

## 🚀 Release Impact

- [ ] This change affects published code, and I have generated a [changeset](https://github.com/changesets/changesets/blob/main/docs/adding-a-changeset.md).
- [x] This change is docs/CI/dev-only (no release).

* **Refactor**
  * Clarified which cache and client methods override core methods; behavior and public APIs are unchanged.
